summary: Improve internal structure while preserving an explicitly defined behavioral contract.

inputs.name: request
inputs.description: Structural problem, intended improvement, scope, and behavior to preserve.

inputs.name: project-context
inputs.description: Current implementation, consumers, boundaries, and verification paths.

inputs.name: test-plan
inputs.description: Relevant behavioral checks and coverage gaps.

completion_checks: Preserved behavior and permitted internal changes are explicit.
The new structure improves the stated problem without unrelated redesign.
Current evidence covers the behavior and compatibility boundaries at risk.
failure_modes: Behavioral preservation cannot be observed adequately: inconclusive.
A required environment or dependent contract is unavailable: blocked.
